Skin wrinkles, dust, and lighting gradients are convincing. However, structural integrity fails significantly in the background/interstitial spaces where the model attempted to render additional elephants; these areas show severe 'melting' and fusion artifacts typical of generative models struggling with crowd density. The animal pose auditor's MEDIUM risk rating (29% low-confidence keypoints) corroborates this structural uncertainty. The cookie has a minor plastic/sheen artifact but is otherwise well-formed. Despite the counting failure and background fusion, the rendered pixels for the visible foreground subjects remain high quality.
